sections.title: Why Muscles Work in Pairs
points: Because muscles only pull, two muscles are needed to move a bone back and forth.
Antagonistic muscles are pairs that work in opposition: when one contracts, the other relaxes.

sections.title: The Thigh Team: Quads & Hamstrings
points: Quadriceps: Located at the front of the thigh. They contract to straighten the leg.
Hamstrings: Located at the back of the thigh. They contract to bend the leg.
During daily routines, we use Biceps more than Triceps because we lift objects against gravity.

sections.text: When a muscle contracts, it becomes shorter, thicker, and harder. When it relaxes, it becomes longer, thinner, and softer.

cards.fact: A muscle that bends a joint (like the Bicep).
A muscle that straightens a joint (like the Tricep).
